support_claim: CRM record HEL-441 names Helion Robotics Ltd, commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, and billing invoices use Helion Robotics Limited as the billed name.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY is licensed because the packet provides establishing evidence—not mere compatibility—linking crm:HEL-441 to Helion Robotics Ltd and explicitly asserting that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, with the billing referent matching the invoice billed name; the packet does not preserve multiple live candidates or state that identity cannot be established.
